basic.label: Basic
basic.description: This discipline is a foundational training path that other disciplines may build upon.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: This discipline requires one or more other disciplines to be taken in order to spec into it.

combat.label: Combat
combat.description: This discipline has majority of its features for combat.

defensive.label: Defensive
defensive.description: This discipline has some features that provide additional Armour or Reactions that increase defence.

divine.label: Divine
divine.description: This discipline is related to the Angels in some way.

inherent.label: Inherent
inherent.description: This discipline grants innate, inherent abilities that are usually harder to counter.

magic.label: Magic
magic.description: This discipline has one or more features related to magic.

marksmanship.label: Marksmanship
marksmanship.description: This discipline grants some ranged Features.

martial.label: Martial
martial.description: This discipline grants some melee Features.

preparation.label: Preparation
preparation.description: This discipline has some Features that prepare things for combat, exploration, etc.

skilled.label: Skilled
skilled.description: This discipline relies heavily upon one of the 10 Skills.

combat.label: Combat
combat.description: This Feature can only be used in combat.

cooperate.label: Cooperate
cooperate.description: This Feature requires a target to be either cooperative or an ally to help with the feature.

detect.label: Detect
detect.description: This Feature can identify or locate an object or creature.

healing.label: Healing
healing.description: This Feature can cause a creature to recover Hit Points or recover from a Condition.

magic.label: Magic
magic.description: This Feature uses some magical ability.

manipulate.label: Manipulate
manipulate.description: This Feature can increase or decrease a circumstance bonus, or change the Action Point cost of a Feature.

melee.label: Melee
melee.description: This Feature can only be used with Melee weapons.

movement.label: Movement
movement.description: This Feature increases or decreases only the movement speed of a creature, object, or vehicle.

psionic.label: Psionic
psionic.description: This Feature uses the mental ability of the user.

preparation.label: Preparation
preparation.description: This Feature requires either multiple Actions or preparation before combat to be utilized.

ranged.label: Ranged
ranged.description: This Feature can only be used with Ranged weapons.

tactical.label: Tactical
tactical.description: This Feature can only be used when certain parameters involving positioning have been met.

technology.label: Technology
technology.description: Requires above Basic training in the skill or weapon to use the Feature.

agile.label: Agile
agile.description: You use your Dexterity for this weapon.

sturdy.label: Sturdy
sturdy.description: You use your Fortitude for this weapon.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description: This weapon is easier to hide. May only be taken on Small or smaller weapons. Gain a +1 CB to hide the weapon. Gain a +2 CB if the weapon is Tiny.

reinforced.label: Reinforced
reinforced.description: If this weapon is used with a Defensive feature, add one DR to yourself temporarily, for the use of blocking an additional point of damage.

throwing.label: Throwing
throwing.description: This weapon's range is triple the base of its size.

illusory.label: Illusory
illusory.description: This weapon does not appear as such. Gain +2 CB to Deception checks involving it. Foes will not be able to tell it is a weapon unless they physically or magically inspect it, at which point the illusion fades.

serrated.label: Serrated
serrated.description: This weapon inflicts Bleeding on an attack roll of 9-10.

weighted.label: Weighted
weighted.description: Critical hits with this weapon also inflict Stunned.

scoped.label: Scoped
scoped.description: Increase the base effective range of this weapon by 5 units, before adding any other modifiers.

close.label: Close
close.description: This weapon ignores the penalty for making attacks within 1 unit of an enemy.

reliable.label: Reliable
reliable.description: This weapon only takes 1 AP to unjam, instead of the usual 2 AP. (Jamming occurs when a 1 is rolled on the ranged attack.)

unstable.label: Unstable
unstable.description: This weapon does an extra 2 Damage on each hit, but it breaks when it would usually jam. Additionally this weapon jams on a roll of 1 or 2. It becomes unusable and must be fixed for 200 NAD.

wardshield.label: Wardshield
wardshield.description: This weapon has a ward attached to the front of it. This can be broken, but while active, grants +2 Damage Resistance (DR) against Magical attacks. Can be broken by attacks with Spellbreaker, an attack that is <= 5 + Armour of the target, or by a Nullify Sigil.

piercing.label: Piercing
piercing.description: This weapon does one quarter of damage rolled or 1d6 Damage (whichever is more) to an enemy behind the one you initially hit, so long as the Attack still passes their Armour. This can be used to attack an enemy behind cover, so long as it is thinner than 10 cm.

extendedMagazine.label: Extended Magazine
extendedMagazine.description: Increase the magazine capacity of ranged weapons with this trait by 2.

impervious.label: Impervious
impervious.description: This weapon takes reduced damage from attacks or defenses that would break or reduce its condition.

phasing.label: Phasing
phasing.description: This weapon can ignore DR once per turn, up to 3 or the Stat being used to attack with. For example, if your Dexterity Stat is +2, you may ignore 2 points of an enemy's total DR to your attack. This Feature has no effect if your Stat is negative.

returning.label: Returning
returning.description: This weapon returns to the wielder if it is dropped or disarmed, within 5 units. This can only happen once per turn, and only happens if the wielder is conscious. The item cannot return in such a way if an enemy or obstacle is between the item and the player.

splitting.label: Splitting
splitting.description: This weapon can split into two smaller versions of itself, reducing its size by two stages. This cannot be used on Tiny or Small weapons.

amphibious.label: Amphibious
amphibious.description: This weapon functions submerged without any penalty.

oiled.label: Oiled
oiled.description: This weapon suffers less of the total penalty from any self-imposed reductions To Hit. Reduce the total penalty by 1 (minimum -1).

heirloom.label: Heirloom
heirloom.description: This weapon is worth more than the usual value (120% usual value), and grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to the Attack Roll against enemies with an eye for wealth or knowledge of history. (This feature can only be selected when initially creating the weapon.)

spellbreaker.label: Spellbreaker
spellbreaker.description: This weapon shatters Wards on a hit, causing the caster to succeed on a Knowledge check DC equal to 8 or the damage rolled, whichever is higher.

magitech.label: Magitech
magitech.description: This weapon can have its damage dice allocated into elemental damage, instead of its normal damage type (Ex. 2d6 Piercing -> 1d6 Piercing and 1d6 Fire).
